capability.full_fixture_cmm_reason: Fixture X extent >=1.6 m exceeds Axiom X 0.64 m and Y 0.9 m; separate assembled survey required
limits: Envelope screens omit workholding/probe/stylus access and machining force; cutting/machining/metrology trials remain required

capacity.limiting_evidence: Bed-only estimate, not a factory throughput guarantee. Mixing, reinforcing, stressing, concrete release strength, cranage, storage, transport and labour cycles unmeasured.
capacity.occupation_definition: Two working days for full bed occupation including preparation, cure, stripping and turnaround. Not inferred from 48 h cure alone.

open: Solid end diaphragms are a new geometry hypothesis; canonical zones do not establish this concrete design
Prestress screen uses bare prismatic section and self-weight only; it omits local diaphragm stiffness/weight effects
No railway live-load model adopted here; this is not a railway beam acceptance calculation
Hypothetical 40-strand layout needs cover, spacing, release strength, stress, cracking, shear and fatigue checks
Additional 20% loss is a research scenario after elastic shortening, not a measured total loss
Euler is ideal elastic pinned screening; brace forces, restraints, imperfections and bed abutments unqualified
Crane scalar capacity screen excludes lifting insert, rigging geometry, eccentricity, stability and runway resistance

design_basis.scope: Baghdad six-car component/assembly factory and pilot Pi20/Pi25 yard

basis.basis: Research design alternatives and load-path requirements. None of these values is a supplier-certified configuration or adopted design allowable.

bed.brace_response_basis: Linearised second-order response about a stress-free sinusoidal bow with initially unstressed springs; this is not a qualified brace force or capacity
bed.initial_bow_basis: Sinusoidal 10 mm research bow; springs unstressed in that initial shape. No fabrication tolerance or brace design criterion adopted.
bed.requirement: Provide an absolute lateral restraint load path in BOTH buckling planes; transverse ties alone leave the common-sway mode unrestrained

open: Zero tension is a research screen, not an adopted design criterion; concrete compression limits unknown
Transfer length, bond, local end stresses, bursting, bearing/insert zones and actual end-section stiffness need separate design
Gross prismatic elastic shortening with local gravity moment is an idealisation; no measured total loss or nonlinear cracking model
Additional reinforcement, equipment/track/railway loads, fatigue, shear, deflection and concrete transfer strength remain open
prestress.scope: Gross prismatic section at full-force stations, including end-fill gravity patches and known strand displacement. Full force extrapolated to ends is a diagnostic; actual transmission/end-zone behaviour is unresolved.

manufacturing_interfaces.route: Baseplate drilling/machining and long-girder fabrication require an additional qualified route; the pilot CV5 cell does not cover them

open: Masses, dynamic factor, wheel count/spacing and approach are OSR scenarios, not Street configuration data
Runway stress/deflection are gross elastic demands: wheel contact/web patch/local buckling, lateral stability, torsion, weld fatigue, rail clips and end stops remain open
Nominal 2.5 m pads are CAD reservations; pressure excludes eccentricity, uplift, seismic, adjacent foundations and actual ground capacity
Horizontal action is a separate assumed interface scenario; no project load combination or base stiffness adopted
Rail, clips, stiffeners and connections are not included in the stated girder/column dead-load takeoff; final dead loads unknown
Adjacent-bay gravity envelope sums incompatible independent maxima conservatively; not a final column reaction
Holding force is not applied clamping preload; exact spindle position and actual force require supplier/trial evidence
Lateral locator contact, pin bending, friction, mount bolts, weld eccentricity, wall/local plate deformation and anchors remain unqualified
Load cases are declared tool/CG research scenarios, not a qualified operating envelope
Weld demand uses the full largest support reaction at one crossrail end; shear-only nominal throat screen omits joint bending and resistance

fixture.geometry_basis: Nominal sharp-corner RHS; rounded mill sections, welds and fasteners not represented
open: No clamps selected; unilateral locator separation under reversed loads remains open
Payload-only beam bending omits frame self-weight, torsion, weld flexibility, local walls and lateral loads
Nominal geometry mass is a stock estimate, not certified purchased mass
Pin fits, hardness, shims, weld size/procedure, residual distortion and anchor design unqualified
Vertical locator through-holes need retention; side/end pins need removable mount detail
Survey complete assembly separately; part CMM cannot contain full fixture

limits: kinematic rank only; clamp forces, contact stiffness, wear and load capacity require separate evidence

check.qualification: 2D reservations only; door sweeps, evacuation, services, fire separation, swept-paths and crane hook coverage need design
